Chapter 10: The Ongoing Journey of Purpose.
You know, purpose isn’t some finish line you cross one day. It’s really more like a way of living—something that grows and shifts as you move through life. Every experience, every relationship, and every choice you make… they all shape what purpose means to you.
Imagine a grandmother looking back on her life. When she was younger, her purpose was all about building a career. Later on, it became raising a family. Now, she finds meaning in sharing her wisdom, helping her community, and just soaking in the present moment. Each season of her life brought its own unique meaning—its own special call.
Most of us find that purpose isn’t fixed. It’s always evolving. Maybe you’ve known someone who, in their younger years, chased after fame or recognition. Over time, though, they found real satisfaction in quiet acts of kindness. Or think about a woman who poured her heart into building a business, only to realize later that what really lit her up was mentoring others and seeing them grow.
The path to purpose isn’t always clear, and it’s definitely not always easy. There are going to be moments of confusion, times when you feel lost or uncertain about what comes next. But here’s something to pay attention to—people who stay curious and keep listening to that little voice inside, they often find the path reveals itself, step by step. Every choice, every new step brings a bit more understanding.
So what really matters? It’s about moving forward, even when you can’t see the whole road ahead. Stay open. Keep learning. Trust that your journey will unfold in its own time.
Purpose isn’t something you find once and hold onto forever. It’s something you create—over and over—through the way you live, the way you love, and the way you serve others. That’s the ongoing journey. And it’s yours to shape, every single day.
